baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence "ما خطبكن", the women's collective reply, and the wife's singular confession forms a question-answer-counterstatement structure inside 12:51.
baseline_models.mechanism: A consequential matter is reopened through negotiated speech. The women give bounded negative testimony about what they knew, while the wife supplies the missing positive first-person admission; truth is therefore established by non-equivalent witness contributions rather than by one undifferentiated declaration.

activation_trace.role: The grave matter that generates much address makes the opening question a formal reopening of an unresolved affair.
Mutual negotiation over an affair organizes the three speech turns as an evidentiary exchange.
Knowledge as disclosure sets the exact epistemic limit of the women's testimony.
The branch supplies the alleged ugly or harmful act whose absence from their knowledge supports Joseph.
Establishing and displaying truth gives the confession its proof-producing function.
Correspondence between statement, inward knowledge, and event is the conclusion produced by the hearing.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a simple confession that clears Joseph.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages an inquest in which limited witness knowledge and a decisive adverse-party admission jointly produce Joseph's clearance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled "راودتن/راودته" and doubled "عن نفسه" place the same contested construction first in the accusation and then in the confession.
baseline_models.mechanism: Solicitation is a conflict between wills, and its repetition can be heard as sustained back-and-forth pressure. The object is not only Joseph's body or desire but his own intention and self-possession; the wife's admission restores authorship of the attempted displacement to herself and preserves his agency.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally supplies a contest of wills and makes solicitation an attempt to turn another from his position.
The non-dominant mapped branch adds repetition, hesitation, and return, activating sustained pressure rather than one isolated advance.
Self as the very identity of a thing makes "عن نفسه" a boundary around Joseph's own personhood.
The inward domain of intention and discernment makes the attempted diversion also a struggle over Joseph's own resolve.

changed_reading.before: The women made a sexual advance toward Joseph.
changed_reading.after: The repeated solicitation is also a sustained attempt to dislodge Joseph from self-command, and the repeated wording in the confession publicly returns the contested agency to him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The marked phrase "الآن حصحص الحق" interrupts the dialogue immediately before the first-person confession.
baseline_models.mechanism: Truth first emerges from what covered it, then takes a material contour: agitation continues until the matter settles, while truth and truthful speech acquire firmness. The confession is thus the settling point of a previously unstable field of claims.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies disclosure of truth after concealment as the immediate force of the marked verb.
Movement until secure settlement gives the disclosure a processual and material endpoint.
Truth as stable correspondence supplies what finally settles.
Material solidity carries the final description of Joseph from verbal accuracy toward tested firmness.

changed_reading.before: "Now the truth is clear" merely announces a fact.
changed_reading.after: The phrase marks the moment when competing accounts have been moved until they settle into a firm correspondence with the event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The confessor is introduced relationally as "امرأت العزيز" but then speaks with the exposed first person "أنا".
baseline_models.mechanism: A title embedded in strength, prestige, and dominance initially shields the actor inside household rank. Her explicit first person crosses that shield: the socially stronger position names its own coercive action and transfers truthful standing to the previously accused person.

activation_trace.role: The woman named through a relational social identity becomes the grammatical source of the admission.
Strength, prestige, and immunity supply the rank enclosing the confessor.
Dominance and overpowering sharpen the asymmetry that the confession reverses.
Public establishment of truth converts private rank into accountable speech.

changed_reading.before: A woman admits that she solicited Joseph.
changed_reading.after: The protected household rank itself is made to speak in the first person, reversing the earlier power relation and relocating authority in Joseph's truthfulness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: "ما علمنا عليه من سوء" reports what the women did not know, whereas "أنا راودته" reports what the wife did.
baseline_models.mechanism: Negative testimony and confession have different evidentiary shapes. The plural witnesses do not claim exhaustive access to Joseph's essence; they deny knowledge of an adverse act. The singular participant then identifies her own act, allowing the conclusion of truthfulness without flattening the witnesses into omniscience.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure makes the plural statement explicitly bounded by what became known to the speakers.
What would harm or distress Joseph is the adverse predicate denied within that bounded knowledge.
The wife's matching repetition converts the general accusation into a participant's precise admission.
Truthful correspondence is inferred from the fit between bounded witness testimony and the participant's confession.

changed_reading.before: All the women simply declare Joseph wholly innocent.
changed_reading.after: Their statement is disciplined negative testimony, and the wife's participant knowledge supplies the positive fact that completes rather than duplicates it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence repeatedly moves from enigmatic appearance, through reported data and failed expertise, to an account that reaches the event's outcome. Against that sequence, 12:51 reads as the social and forensic interpretation of an opaque earlier affair: speech and visible signs are carried across into their governing meaning, and the one already addressed as truthful is publicly shown to be so.

activation_trace.role: Dream vision supplies the recurring opaque surface that demands interpretation rather than immediate acceptance.
A delivered report supplies the transfer of otherwise inaccessible information into speech.
Returning a thing to its outcome supplies the motion from an obscure sign to what it finally means.
Crossing from the vision's exterior to its meaning makes interpretation an explicit contextual operation.
The court's admitted lack of knowledge creates the epistemic deficit that Joseph's reading repairs.
The title of consummate truthfulness anticipates the quality that the focus hearing will establish publicly.
The focus disclosure completes the contextual passage from obscured surface to revealed reality.

structural_cues: The packet orders dream report, failed elite interpretation, Joseph's successful interpretation, and only then the inquiry into the women.
Joseph is called الصديق at 12:46 before the wife calls him one of the truthful at 12:51.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated report-to-meaning transitions and the repeated truthfulness label; I infer that the inquiry performs an analogous interpretation on social evidence. A live alternative is that the dream sequence merely causes Joseph's release without shaping how the hearing itself should be read.

changed_reading.before: The hearing is an isolated factual inquiry into past misconduct.
changed_reading.after: The hearing is the final interpretation of a previously opaque social event, converting signs, bounded knowledge, and confession into a publicly legible outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth does not arrive on the first royal command. Remembering follows forgetting and prolonged confinement; when the messenger finally comes, Joseph sends the command backward and requires a question about the women. The focus inquiry is therefore an engineered return to the unresolved scene, not a spontaneous royal discovery.

activation_trace.role: Neglect and abandonment explain why the unresolved claim remains institutionally dormant.
Remaining in place gives the suppressed truth a long interval without public resolution.
Recovery after forgetting restarts the chain by which Joseph's knowledge reaches power.
The messenger makes the inquiry depend on relayed commands rather than direct sovereign access.
Return reverses the direction of release and sends authority back to the unexamined event.
The requested question is the operative procedure that produces the focus exchange.
The consequential unresolved matter is what the returned summons finally compels the court to address.

structural_cues: The command chain runs king to messenger, messenger to Joseph, Joseph back toward the ruler, and ruler to the women.
The focus question repeats the subject Joseph specified in 12:50 rather than introducing a new concern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delay, recovered memory, a messenger, Joseph's imperative to return, and the resulting question; I infer a deliberate procedural refusal to accept private release without public review. The weaker alternative is that the return only advances plot logistics.

changed_reading.before: The ruler calls the women and happens to obtain a confession.
changed_reading.after: Joseph from confinement reverses the summons and makes his release wait on a public re-examination that power had left unresolved.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ruler is told to identify the women by their cut hands and to ask about their scheme. Bodily marks therefore carry the hidden event forward when ordinary speech did not; the women's bounded denial and the wife's confession in 12:51 answer an inquiry already keyed to involuntary visible evidence.

activation_trace.role: Physical severing supplies a durable bodily trace that distinguishes the relevant witnesses.
The literal hands locate evidence of the earlier event on the witnesses' bodies.
Questioning converts the bodily index into testimony rather than leaving it as spectacle.
Concealed contrivance names the hidden agency that the visible trace prompts the hearing to recover.
Witness knowledge verbalizes what the bodily evidence alone cannot specify.
The confession establishes the truth toward which the bodily trace pointed.

structural_cues: The immediately preceding ayah identifies the summoned women by the act of cutting their hands.
The focus ayah shifts from that bodily identifier to knowledge, confession, and truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily cuts, a command to question their bearers, and subsequent testimony; I infer that the marks function as evidentiary memory. They may alternatively serve only as a narrative label for the group.

changed_reading.before: 12:51 is a purely verbal contest of claims.
changed_reading.after: Its speech is elicited by embodied traces that preserved the concealed event and forced private knowledge into public testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes judgment from possession of royal power. Joseph speaks of judgment belonging to God, decisively resolves the prisoners' matter, and later is asked for a ruling while the royal elite fail. When the king questions the women, sovereignty is not manufacturing truth; it is belatedly entering an adjudicative order whose reliable knower had been confined.

activation_trace.role: Judgment between people supplies a standard of adjudication explicitly distinguished from ordinary human authority.
A decisive ruling shows Joseph already resolving disputed matters from within confinement.
Royal sovereignty supplies the institutional power that nevertheless lacks the needed interpretation.
The request for a clarifying ruling locates reliable judgment with Joseph rather than with the royal assembly.
Negotiated speech makes the king's question one turn inside inquiry, not truth by fiat.
Reality-grounded truth is the criterion to which the royal procedure finally conforms.

structural_cues: Joseph resolves two prisoners' requested ruling before the king and his assembly fail to resolve the royal vision.
The king's first order to bring Joseph is redirected into an inquiry Joseph specified.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasted sites of judgment, interpretation, and sovereignty; I infer that 12:51 dramatizes authority submitting to an independently grounded truth. A live alternative is that all judgment vocabulary is local to separate episodes and carries no institutional contrast.

changed_reading.before: The king's authority discovers and certifies Joseph's innocence.
changed_reading.after: Royal authority is itself corrected: it must ask the question dictated from prison and conform its record to a truth it did not create.

context_deltas.mechanism: If 12:52-53 gives Joseph's rationale, the focus confession is commissioned evidence for an absent defendant. The hearing makes a relevant authority know that Joseph did not diminish a trust while unseen, and the following refusal of absolute self-acquittal prevents public vindication from becoming a claim that the self is intrinsically beyond evil.

activation_trace.role: Failure of fidelity defines the precise charge that the returned inquiry is meant to negate.
Concealment from sight explains why third-party testimony is needed to clear an absent Joseph.
Making the relevant person know supplies the hearing's intended epistemic result.
Acquittal as separation from liability qualifies how far the vindicated speaker will go in clearing the self.
The inward field of intention keeps moral vulnerability live even after external exoneration.
The same harmful ugliness denied of Joseph in the focus becomes a general possibility toward which the self can command.
The wife's correspondence with the event supplies the absent defendant's needed clearance.

structural_cues: Joseph requested the inquiry in 12:50 but is not shown present at the hearing in 12:51.
The king's renewed command to bring Joseph in 12:54 can frame 12:52-53 as the rationale sent back from him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Joseph's prior request, an absent-party trust claim, and a renewed summons afterward; I assign 12:52-53 provisionally to Joseph and infer that 12:51 is his evidentiary instrument. The equally live alternative is uninterrupted speech by the wife.

changed_reading.before: The wife's confession is a self-contained admission of her act.
changed_reading.after: On the Joseph-voice reading of 12:52-53, her confession is the public evidence an absent prisoner deliberately commissioned to clear an unseen breach of trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: If 12:52-53 continues the wife's speech, "now truth has emerged" opens a longer act of reparative disclosure. She owns solicitation, seeks to end concealed betrayal through truthful speech, and then refuses to declare her own self innocent, locating the prior act within a self that can command toward evil except under mercy.

activation_trace.role: Diminished fidelity makes the confession an attempted repair of trust rather than bare self-description.
What was hidden from sight supplies the concealed condition that present disclosure reverses.
Refusal to separate the self from liability extends the focus confession into self-indictment.
The inward domain of intent relocates solicitation within an account of morally unstable desire.
The focus denial of evil against Joseph is reversed into acknowledgment of the self's capacity to command toward evil.
Merciful tenderness supplies the stated exception to the self's harmful command.
The admitted contest of wills becomes the concrete act to which the following moral self-analysis answers.

structural_cues: No new speech verb intervenes between the wife's statement in 12:51 and the first-person statements in 12:52-53.
The movement from "أنا راودته" to "وما أبرئ نفسي" is grammatically available as a continuous first-person confession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uninterrupted first-person clauses, repeated self and evil roots, and a mercy exception; I provisionally continue the wife's voice and infer a confession deepening into moral diagnosis. The competing Joseph-voice reading remains fully live.

changed_reading.before: The wife admits one past action and declares Joseph truthful.
changed_reading.after: On the continuous-wife reading, the admission begins a reparative self-indictment that distinguishes Joseph's vindication from any claim that her own desiring self is innocent.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus establishes truthful speech, the king seeks to separate Joseph out for himself, speaks with him, calls him secure and trusted, and then hears Joseph name himself guardian and knower over the storehouses. Truthfulness is converted from reputational clearance into tested institutional reliability.

activation_trace.role: Purification from mixture supplies the transition from contested accusation to being selected out as clear.
Intelligible speech connecting interlocutors makes direct conversation the ruler's further test.
Established standing turns vindication into recognized institutional position.
Settled confidence and trust are the social consequence of the truthfulness established in 12:51.
Safekeeping stored goods supplies the concrete public trust for which Joseph becomes eligible.
Guarding and attentive preservation translate personal integrity into administrative function.
Knowledge joins fidelity, making truthful standing a competence claim rather than innocence alone.
Complete and stable truthfulness becomes the character basis for entrusted office.

structural_cues: The sequence moves directly from public truth in 12:51 to renewed summons, direct speech, trust, and stewardship in 12:54-55.
The same knowledge root used for witness knowledge in 12:51 returns as Joseph's qualification in 12:55.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate narrative succession from vindication to conversation, trust, and guardianship; I infer that the hearing converts truthfulness into institutional credit. Dream interpretation and economic planning remain alternative or additional grounds for appointment.

changed_reading.before: The confession merely repairs Joseph's damaged reputation.
changed_reading.after: The confession publicly certifies a durable truthfulness that can be tested in speech and converted into trust over collective resources.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activation is surprising because "خطب" in context denotes a consequential matter, not a literal marriage proposal. It remains anchored because the same focus root carries a courtship branch beside doubled solicitation and a named woman; downstream prose should present this only as a lexical undertone that reverses gendered agency, never as the clause's direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "ما خطبكن" stands beside doubled "راود" and the explicit "امرأت العزيز" within the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Courtship and seeking a woman add a faint proposal-field echo to the question about female solicitation.
The explicit contesting solicitation places the women in the active seeking role.
The marked female social identity fixes the gendered reversal in the confessor herself.

changed_reading.after: A contained courtship echo makes the inquiry expose an inverted seeking script: elite women occupy the active suitor-like position while Joseph resists being redirected.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy, not an etymological equation between pressing and "حصحص". It remains worth carrying because pressure brackets the context, preservation under enclosure fills the interval, and the rare focus verb itself has movement-until-settlement; downstream prose should qualify truth as being "as if" pressed out after containment and delay.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "الآن حصحص الحق" uses a rare disclosure verb whose branch inventory includes movement until stable settlement.

activation_trace.role: Pressure until liquid emerges opens the packet's context with an extraction image.
Leaving produce in place supplies deliberate withholding rather than immediate use.
Preservation inside an enclosure supplies the protected latency between production and release.
Renewed pressing at relief closes the material sequence with yielded contents.
Agitation until settlement anchors the analogy in the focus disclosure rather than in agriculture alone.
A tightly made, reliable result gives the yielded truth a finished material quality.

changed_reading.before: Truth suddenly appears when the wife decides to speak.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, truth behaves like a latent yield held through a long enclosure and finally brought out under renewed pressure until it settles.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The wound branch of "كلم" is form-distant from ordinary speaking in 12:54, so this cannot govern the literal reading. It remains anchored by the focus's three speech acts and the immediately prior cut hands, which let bodily and verbal marks converge as evidence; downstream prose should name this as a secondary word-image only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Three forms of "قال" produce truth in 12:51 after 12:50 identifies witnesses by cut hands and before 12:54 tests Joseph by speaking with him.

activation_trace.role: Literal cutting supplies bodily marks left by the concealed event.
The marked hands make the wound evidentiary and socially identifiable.
Voiced statements supply the verbal marks from which the hearing establishes the event.
The branch image of a bodily wound lets later speech resonate with marks that disclose what happened.
Established truth is the shared result drawn from bodily trace and spoken admission.

changed_reading.before: Only testimony establishes the past event.
changed_reading.after: In a contained word-image, wounds and words are parallel marks: cut hands retain the event bodily, and voiced confession makes that retained event intelligible.

strongest_changes: Joseph's backward command through the messenger turns 12:51 from a royal favor into a prisoner-directed public review.
The long interpretation sequence makes the hearing a social ta'wil that carries opaque signs into a publicly stable account.
The exact return of self and evil language in 12:53 changes solicitation into a conflict over self-command and preserves both Joseph-voice and wife-voice continuities.
The post-hearing movement from truthful to trusted and guarding makes vindication an institutional qualification, not reputation repair alone.
summary.what_was_special: The rare settling verb, doubled solicitation and self construction, embodied hand marks, delayed return of the summons, and unmarked speaker transition after the confession generated several coexisting mechanisms rather than one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 12:52-53 continues the wife's confession or gives Joseph's rationale cannot be resolved from the packet without collapsing a productive ambiguity.
The non-dominant ر د د activation under ر و د and the pressure/yield analogy are diagnostically fertile but should remain explicitly exploratory.
Joseph's appointment follows vindication, interpretation, and direct royal conversation, so no single one should be claimed as its sole cause.
